lines.en: label otohaspring2:
scene noonsky
There’s someone I want to see.
lines.zh: 有个人我想见。

lines.en: Someone I’ve been mostly neglecting since waking up from my makeshift coma.
lines.zh: 自从从我那场临时昏迷里醒来之后，我基本一直在冷落的一个人。

lines.en: It’s someone who always manages to take the pain away, replacing it with an ever-growing darkness that, strangely enough, makes me feel like I’m home.
lines.zh: 她总能带走我的痛苦，取而代之的是一种不断膨胀的黑暗——说来也怪，那黑暗却让我有种回家的感觉。

lines.en: Maybe it’s because the darkness she fills me with blends in nicely with the kind I’ve created myself but, regardless-
lines.zh: 也许是因为她灌进我身体里的那份黑暗，和我自己造出来的那份融合得很好吧。不过不管怎样——

lines.en: There’s someone I want to see.
lines.zh: 有个人我想见。

lines.en: scene buddybug
There’s someone I want to see.
lines.zh: 有个人我想见。

lines.en: She’s someone who should not exist, but she does anyway.
lines.zh: 她是个本不该存在的人，可她偏偏就存在。

lines.en: She’s someone who eats rumors and turns their tiny bones to special lines we can make ladders with.
lines.zh: 她以流言为食，把那些细小的骨头变成特别的句子，好让我们用来搭成梯子。

lines.en: She sleeps in a box in a place beneath the subway and masturbates furiously to the sounds a stepson makes.
lines.zh: 她睡在地铁底下某处的一个纸箱里，听着继子发出的声音疯狂自慰。

lines.en: I want to hold her hand and see if I can find any pink or black hairs. The smell of propane. That dim, auburn glow.
lines.zh: 我想握住她的手，看看能不能找到任何粉色或黑色的毛发。丙烷的气味。那暗淡的赭红色微光。

lines.en: We met one another inside of a beaker.
lines.zh: 我们是在一只烧杯里相遇的。

lines.en: She spat in my mouth and made me eat last week’s supper.
lines.zh: 她往我嘴里吐了口唾沫，逼我吃下上周的晚饭。

lines.en: I often think about ripping her hair out and stapling it onto the scalp of someone who needs it more.
lines.zh: 我常常想把她的头发一根根拔下来，钉在更需要它的人的头皮上。

lines.en: Can you hear this, Kyoko?
lines.zh: 你听见了吗，Kyoko？

lines.en: Your daughter is a nightmare.
lines.zh: 你女儿就是个噩梦。

lines.en: She has my eyes.
lines.zh: 她有一双我的眼睛。

lines.en: scene noonsky
Ignore that.
lines.zh: 当我走到图书馆时，我发现今天 Nodoka 身边跟了个相当奇怪的人。

lines.en: Anyway, there’s someone I want to see.
lines.zh: 算了，先别管那个。总之，有个人我想见。

lines.en: Her name is Nodoka Nagasawa, and I’m going to fuck her mouth until her teeth fall out.
lines.zh: 她叫 Nodoka Nagasawa，我要操她的嘴，直到她的牙齿全部掉光。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohanodokalibrary1
When I make it to the library, I find that Nodoka is accompanied by someone rather strange today.
lines.zh: 当我走到图书馆时，我发现今天 Nodoka 身边跟了个相当奇怪的人。

lines.en: Well...not strange in the sense that these two aren’t often seen together. But the sense where Otoha doesn’t typically- ah, fuck it. You know what I mean.
lines.zh: 嗯……倒不是说她们俩不常在一块儿。而是 Otoha 一般不……啊，管他呢。你懂我意思。

lines.en: Either way, both of them are here — which means there will be no mouth-fucking unless Otoha’s looking to broaden her horizons so wide that I can sort of just sneak my way into her sex-life.
lines.zh: 总之，她们俩都在——也就是说今天不会有口交了，除非 Otoha 想把自己的眼界拓宽到能让我顺道挤进她的性生活里。

lines.en: That would be neat. She has nice legs. They both do.
lines.zh: 那样倒也不错。她腿很好看。她们俩都是。

lines.en: : You guys have nice legs.
lines.zh: 你俩腿都很好看。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary2
scene otohanodokalibrary1
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : No problem, Otoha. Just here to provide some encouragement so you two can study more effectively.
lines.zh: : 不客气，Otoha。我只是来给你们打打气，好让你俩更高效地学习。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary3
: Wait, yeah. What {i}are{/i} you doing here?
lines.zh: : 等等，说真的。你{i}到底{/i}来这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I just told you.
lines.zh: : 我刚说过了啊。

lines.en: : No, I mean like...I thought you were trying to stay away from this place? Does this mean you’re coming back to school now?
lines.zh: : 不，我是说……我以为你在躲着这地方呢？这是不是意味着你打算回学校了？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. I’m here to see Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。我是来找 Nodoka 的。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary4
: I’m Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我是 Nodoka。

lines.en: : Are you free right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在有空吗？

lines.en: : That depends. Is this your way of subtly asking me to have sex with you without directly revealing the nature of our extremely passionate relationship to my roommate?
lines.zh: : 那要看情况。这是你拐着弯问我上床、同时又不想让我室友知道我们这段"极其热烈的关系"的方式吗？

lines.en: : Your words, not mine.
lines.zh: : 这话是你说的，不是我。

lines.en: : Not to mention your roommate already knows about your “extremely passionate relationship.” I heard it {i}loud{/i} and clear, remember?
lines.zh: : 更别提你室友早就知道你们那段"极其热烈的关系"了。我听得{i}清清楚楚{/i}，记得吗？

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary5
: Oh, right. I took quite a beating that night and must only {i}now{/i} be experiencing the adverse effects of having my head pressed up against the wall for so long.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。那天晚上我挨了顿狠的，准是到{i}现在{/i}才出现后遗症——头被按在墙上顶了那么久。

lines.en: : No. I think you’re just being a douche.
lines.zh: : 不。我觉得你就是个混蛋。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary6
: Perhaps. I think the more likely explanation, though, is that I’m just a bit preoccupied at the moment. My mind can only handle so much at once, you know.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。不过我觉得更可能的解释是，我这会儿有点心事重重。你知道的，我的脑子一次只能装下这么多东西。

lines.en: : That’s news to me.
lines.zh: : 这我倒是头一回听说。

lines.en: : Nodoka’s been caught up in some weird research loop lately. And I’m pretty sure it’s about you, so if you could just spill your heart out to her or whatever, it might save all of us some time and trouble.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 最近陷进了一个奇怪的研究循环里。而且我敢说那研究跟你有关，所以你要是干脆把心里话都倒给她还是怎么的，说不定能替我们所有人省下不少时间和麻烦。

lines.en: : I’m afraid there’s nothing Akira could tell me that would aid in my research, but yes. That is a thing I am currently doing. Which means I must regretfully deny your invitation to “Pound Town.”
lines.zh: : 恐怕 Akira 能告诉我的、对我的研究有帮助的东西一点都没有。不过没错，我确实在做那么一件事。也就是说，我只能遗憾地拒绝你"去开炮镇"的邀请了。

lines.en: : I can be quick.
lines.zh: : 我可以很快。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re really just shameless now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你现在是真的一点都不害臊了，是吧？

lines.en: : If it’s quick, I’m sure Otoha can handle it. She might ask you to call her “Onee-chan,” though.
lines.zh: : 如果够快的话，我相信 Otoha 受得住。不过她可能会让你叫她"Onee-chan"。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary7
: Hah...
: Alright, Otoha. Let’s do this. We don’t have to look at each other if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 好了，Otoha。来吧。你要是不想看我，我们可以不看对方。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary8
: Come on, man. I’ve actually kind of missed you. Please don’t go making things weird just a few seconds into our reunion.
lines.zh: : 拜托，老兄。我其实还挺想你的。我们才刚重聚几秒钟，你可别把气氛弄得这么怪。

lines.en: : Hey, get mad at Nodoka, not me. She’s the one who volunteered you. And she works here, so I was under the impression her word was law.
lines.zh: : 嘿，要怪就怪 Nodoka，别怪我。是她主动把你让出来的。而且她在这儿上班，所以我还以为她的话就是规矩。

lines.en: : {i}Akira,{/i} I know your brain’s all scrambled and shit right now, but I’d like to remind you that this is a library, not a brothel.
lines.zh: : {i}Akira，{/i}我知道你脑子这会儿乱成一锅粥什么的，但我想提醒你，这里是图书馆，不是妓院。

lines.en: : A library is just a brothel for knowledge.
lines.zh: : 图书馆就是知识的妓院。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary9
: He raises a fair point.
lines.zh: : 他说得有道理。

lines.en: : No he doesn’t! And even if he did, wouldn’t that imply I can just, like...{i}educate{/i} him?!
lines.zh: : 他有个屁的道理！就算有，那岂不是意味着我可以……{i}教育{/i}他？！

lines.en: : Stop yelling in the knowledge brothel. It’s against the rules.
lines.zh: : 别在知识妓院里大喊大叫。违反规定。

lines.en: : Can you put a leash on your pet, please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能给你的宠物套根绳子？

lines.en: : That’s the whole reason I came here and now it’s starting to sound like I’m going to have to fuck a book.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿就是为了这个，现在听着倒像是我非得去操一本书了。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary10
: Well, fuck whatever you want so long as it’s not me. I have work to do, and it’s imperative that I finish this section before I lose my train of thought.
lines.zh: : 随你操什么，只要不是我就行。我有活儿要干，而且我必须在思路断掉之前把这一节写完，这很要紧。

lines.en: : I have work to do {i}too{/i}, you know? I’ve been working on this song non-stop and it’s still all...not good and shit.
lines.zh: 我{i}也{/i}有活儿要干，好吗？这首歌我一直在不停地写，可它还是……烂得要死什么的。

lines.en: : Then perhaps you can find inspiration in the arms of an older man? That’s what Tchaikovsky would have done.
lines.zh: : 那也许你能在一个年长男人的怀抱里找到灵感？柴可夫斯基就会这么做。

lines.en: : I don’t know how to play piano, but I can assure you I am still very good with my-
lines.zh: : 我不会弹钢琴，但我可以向你保证，我用我的——

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary11
: Do not, under any circumstance, finish that sentence.
lines.zh: : 无论在任何情况下，都别把那句话说完。

lines.en: : If you’re okay with just {i}hanging out and talking,{/i} I’ll take a break with you for a little while. And, before you ask, no. “Hanging out and talking” is not Zoomer slang for hooking up.
lines.zh: : 如果你可以只是{i}待在一起聊聊天{/i}，我可以陪你休息一会儿。另外，在你开口之前先说清楚：不。"待在一起聊聊天"不是 Z 世代的黑话，跟勾搭没关系。

lines.en: : You actually want to hang out with me?
lines.zh: : 你真想跟我待在一起？

lines.en: : When has what I want to do ever mattered to you before? Your favorite pastime is barging into my room and pretending to watch porn while I’m on the phone with my parents.
lines.zh: : 我想做什么，什么时候对你重要过？你最大的爱好就是闯进我的房间，在我跟父母通电话时装作在看黄片。

lines.en: : True. But don’t let my infallible comedic senses fool you, Otoha. I’m just a step or two away from breaking into a million pieces right now and things could get pretty messy {i}really{/i} quickly.
lines.zh: : 说得对。不过别让我那无懈可击的幽默感骗了你，Otoha。我现在离碎成一百万片只差一两步，而且事情可能{i}很{/i}快就会变得相当难看。

lines.en: : Then please go elsewhere {i}now{/i} as I do not want little bits of Akira all over my notebook. That is what my {i}face{/i} is for.
lines.zh: : 那就请{i}现在{/i}去别的地方吧，我可不想我的笔记本上溅满 Akira 的碎片。那是留给我{i}脸{/i}上的。

lines.en: : Come on, Sensei. Let’s let the genius do her {i}research.{/i}
lines.zh: : 走吧，老师。让这位天才继续做她的{i}研究{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha gets up from the table and closes her notebook, throwing it on top of a stack of about ten others as I’m reminded that Nodoka isn’t the only imperfect perfectionist around.
lines.zh: Otoha 从桌边站起来合上笔记本，把它扔到大约十本其他笔记本的堆上，这让我意识到，Nodoka 并不是这附近唯一一个不完美的完美主义者。

lines.en: As we make our way to the opposite end of the library, I can’t help but worry that the man I’ve become will make the wrong impression on Otoha and taint the sapling of a relationship we’ve formed so far.
lines.zh: 我们往图书馆另一头走的时候，我忍不住担心，如今变成这样的我会给 Otoha 留下错误的印象，会玷污我们至今培育出的那株关系的幼苗。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog1
scene black
But then I remember Yumi.
lines.zh: 但接着我想起了 Yumi。

lines.en: And I remember that she and I barely have a relationship at all.
lines.zh: 我想起我和她之间几乎称不上有任何关系。

lines.en: And that this broken part of me somehow brought her {i}closer.{/i}
lines.zh: 而我想起，我身上这个破碎的部分，反而把她拉得{i}更近{/i}了。

lines.en: Has that been the key all along?
lines.zh: 难道这一直就是关键？

lines.en: Do these stupid, unknowing teenagers eat up vulnerability the same way {i}I{/i} do?
lines.zh: 这些愚蠢又浑然不觉的青少年，也会像{i}我{/i}一样把脆弱当饭吃吗？

lines.en: Are they trying to take advantage of {i}me{/i} now?
lines.zh: 她们现在是在想办法利用{i}我{/i}吗？

lines.en: Does Otoha want my COCK?
lines.zh: Otoha 想要我的鸡巴吗？

lines.en: Does she want my BIG, THROBBING COCK?
lines.zh: 她想要我那根又大又跳动的鸡巴吗？

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary12
No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: No she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 她不想要。

lines.en: And I need to calm down.
lines.zh: 我得冷静下来。

lines.en: I need to remember where I am and {i}who{/i} I am.
lines.zh: 我需要记住自己身在何处，{i}我{/i}是谁。

lines.en: What pieces I have left and the ones I need to find.
lines.zh: 我还剩哪些碎片，又需要找回哪些。

lines.en: And none of them are inside of her.
lines.zh: 而它们没有一块在她身体里。

lines.en: : So...how are you holding up?
lines.zh: : 那么……你最近撑得怎么样？

lines.en: But I suppose if they are, I can just pull them out of her stomach once she’s sleeping.
lines.zh: 不过我想，如果真在里面，等她睡着了我再从她肚子里掏出来就行。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary13
: I almost jumped off a bridge the other day. That was fun.
lines.zh: : 前几天我差点从桥上跳下去。还挺好玩的。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary14
: You...{i}what?{/i}
: I don’t know if I should say it again based on that expression.
lines.zh: : 看你这表情，我不知道该不该再说一遍。

lines.en: : Are you a fucking idiot? Why would you do that?
lines.zh: : 你他妈是个白痴吗？你为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : I don’t know. It kind of just happened.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。就是那么发生了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty much just running on auto-pilot now. I don’t really have anything left to lose.
lines.zh: : 我现在基本就是靠自动驾驶在活着。我已经没什么可失去的了。

lines.en: : You have fucking {i}tons{/i} to lose, man. I know a handful of girls who’d straight up just crumble if anything bad ever happened to you. Just think of Niki.
lines.zh: : 你他妈还有{i}一大堆{/i}可以失去的，老兄。我认识好几个女孩，你要是出了什么意外，她们会当场崩溃掉。光想想 Niki 就知道。

lines.en: : I’ve been trying not to.
lines.zh: : 我一直尽量不去想。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i} She loves you.
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i} 她爱你啊。

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} why.
lines.zh: : {i}就是因为这个。{/i}

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary15
: Niki’s too good to be true.
lines.zh: : Niki 好得不像是真的。

lines.en: : And not only do I not deserve her, but she {i}confuses{/i} me. Or maybe I just don’t actually want to feel better. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 而且先不说我配不上她，她还让我{i}很困惑{/i}。又或者我只是根本就不想好起来。我不知道。

lines.en: : That’s why I’m here to see Nodoka. I {i}get{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 所以我才来见 Nodoka。我{i}懂{/i}她。

lines.en: : Nobody {i}gets{/i} Nodoka, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没有人{i}懂{/i} Nodoka，老师。

lines.en: : I just mean I “get” what our relationship is.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是我"懂"我们之间是什么关系。

lines.en: : I can hide inside of her when what I’m feeling becomes too much to bear.
lines.zh: : 当我的感受变得难以承受时，我可以躲进她里面。

lines.en: : Can you not do that with Niki?
lines.zh: : 跟 Niki 在一起就不能这样吗？

lines.en: : I can. But what Nodoka takes away is different.
lines.zh: : 能。但 Nodoka 带走的东西不一样。

lines.en: : Niki walks away with {i}love{/i} when I’m done with her. All Nodoka gets is a chance to feel human for a little while. Or maybe, like...research or something. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我结束之后，Niki 带走的是{i}爱{/i}。而 Nodoka 得到的，只有一次短暂地觉得自己像个人的机会。又或者……像是研究之类的。我也不知道。

lines.en: : But whatever it is, it’s not love. Just a little escapism. And I think the only reason it works for the two of us is because we’re not great at feeling things the way other people are.
lines.zh: : 但不管那是什么，都不是爱。只是一次小小的逃避。而且我觉得这招之所以对我们俩都管用，是因为我们都不太擅长像别人那样去感受。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary16
: Well, call me crazy, but you seem more relatable than ever right now. And that’s {i}because{/i} you’re feeling all this shit.
lines.zh: : 好吧，就算我疯了吧，可你现在给我的感觉比以往任何时候都更接地气。而那正是{i}因为{/i}你在感受这些破事。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be relatable. I just want to be complacent.
lines.zh: : 我不想接地气。我只想得过且过。

lines.en: : I don’t need happiness or love or anything like that — just a moment or two of silence and a cute girl I can bury myself in when porn won’t do the trick anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不需要幸福、爱情或者那一类的东西——只要一两分钟的安静，还有一个当黄片都不管用时能让我把自己埋进去的可爱女孩。

lines.en: : I can’t...really tell if you’re just messing with me right now or if all of this is actually legit.
lines.zh: : 我……真分不清你现在是在逗我玩，还是这一切都是真的。

lines.en: : What’s confusing you?
lines.zh: : 什么让你困惑？

lines.en: : Well, the fact that you’ve never been this open for one.
lines.zh: : 首先，你从来没这么坦白过。

lines.en: : Like I said, I have nothing to lose now.
lines.zh: : 我说了，我现在没什么可失去的了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but second thing is just...how fucking dumb all of this is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但第二点就是……这一切他妈的有多蠢。

lines.en: : Dumb?
scene otohanodokalibrary17
: {i}Just a moment or two of silence and a cute girl I can bury myself in when porn won’t do the trick anymore...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}"只要一两分钟的安静，还有一个当黄片都不管用时能让我把自己埋进去的可爱女孩"……{/i}

lines.en: : No offense, but you sound like some twelve-year old edgelord who just got rejected by a girl for the first time ever.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，但你听起来就像某个十二岁的中二病，这辈子头一回被女生拒绝。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary18
: Which...is fine. If that’s how you really feel. But I don’t think it is. I think you’re just...having trouble articulating what’s actually going on or...or something like that.
lines.zh: : 不过……那也行。如果你真是这么想的。但我觉得不是。我觉得你只是……说不清楚到底发生了什么，或者……之类的。

lines.en: : I will admit that it’s been very long since I’ve attempted to properly {i}articulate{/i} my feelings.
lines.zh: : 我承认，我已经很久没有好好地{i}表达{/i}过自己的感受了。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary19
: Then try that instead of wandering all the way across town to have sex with a teenager!
lines.zh: : 那就试试去表达啊，别再跑遍全城去跟一个十几岁的女孩上床！

lines.en: : You can make yourself feel better from the comfort of your own home {i}without{/i} having to worry about accidentally plaguing the world with another Nodoka-spawn.
lines.zh: : 你舒舒服服待在自己家里就能让自己好起来，{i}用不着{/i}担心一不小心又给世界添了个 Nodoka 二代。

lines.en: : Two Nodokas sounds horrible in terms of daily life. Sexually, though-
lines.zh: : 两个 Nodoka，日常生活听起来会很可怕。不过在性方面嘛——

lines.en: : I don’t need to hear about that part! Just stop being a downer and pull yourself together, dude. I’m sure you’ll find whatever it is that you apparently lost and, if you don’t-
lines.zh: : 那部分我不需要听！别再这么丧了，振作起来，老兄。我相信你总能找回你显然弄丢的东西，要是找不回来——

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary20
: There are a million other things out there that’ll fill the void once you stop crying.
lines.zh: : 等你不再哭的时候，外面还有上百万种别的东西能填满那份空虚。

lines.en: : And if there aren’t?
lines.zh: : 要是没有呢？

lines.en: : Then you’re probably holding yourself back on purpose.
lines.zh: : 那大概是你自己在故意拖后腿。

lines.en: : You good now, little bro?
lines.zh: : 你现在好了吗，小老弟？

lines.en: : I forget how much I like you sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我有时候会忘了自己有多喜欢你。

lines.en: : You’d remember if I tried harder. I’m pretty good at minding my own business when I’m not destroying relationships and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我要是再努力一点你就会想起来了。我除了搞破坏关系什么的，其实还挺擅长管好自己那摊事的。

lines.en: : You haven’t destroyed ours yet. I’m still hesitant to call you {i}Onee-chan,{/i} though, given that you’re only half my age.
lines.zh: : 你还没毁掉我们的关系呢。不过考虑到你只有我一半年纪，我还是不太愿意叫你"{i}Onee-chan{/i}"。

lines.en: : Yeah, definitely...don’t do that. The “little bro” thing was just a joke. Nodoka’s only fucking around when she says all that stuff about me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，千万别……别那么叫。"小老弟"只是个玩笑。Nodoka 说那些关于我的话，都只是在逗你玩。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Nodoka has accurately predicted the sexual behavior of at least one other person that I did not see coming, so I’m inclined to believe her intuition when it comes to this stuff.
lines.zh: : 那可不好说。Nodoka 至少准确预测过一个我完全没料到的人的性行为，所以在这类事上我倾向于相信她的直觉。

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 拜托别。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary21
: If only I had experience being sexually attracted to people younger than me. Maybe then I would be able to understand your outlook on this.
lines.zh: : 要是我有过对比我年轻的人产生性欲的经验就好了。那样我也许就能理解你这想法了。

lines.en: : Really don’t.
lines.zh: : 真的别。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary22
: You seem a little persistent, Otoha. Why?
lines.zh: : Otoha，你好像有点执着啊。为什么？

lines.en: : I just don’t want you to get distracted from the topic at hand. This is a conversation where I lend you a shoulder and you get some tears on it or something. It has nothing to do with me.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你跑题。这场对话是我借个肩膀给你、你在上面蹭点眼泪什么的，跟我没关系。

lines.en: : Thankfully, your wise words have led to an immediate full recovery on my end. Thank you for saving my life, Otoha. Now, it is time to discuss your sexual preferences.
lines.zh: : 幸好你这一番至理名言让我立刻彻底痊愈了。谢谢你救了我一命，Otoha。现在，是时候来讨论一下你的性偏好了。

lines.en: : Why do you always have to ruin literally everything?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非得把每一件事都搞砸？

lines.en: : Isn’t that what little brothers do?
lines.zh: : 做弟弟的不就是干这个的吗？

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary23
: I mean...{i}yeah.{/i} But you’re like six feet tall and-
lines.zh: : 我意思是……{i}是啊。{/i}可你都一米八几了，而且——

lines.en: : You’re blushing now. This really is a thing for you, huh?
lines.zh: : 你脸红了。这事对你来说还真是上了心啊，嗯？

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary24
: No! It’s...I...
lines.zh: : 才没有！那是……我……

lines.en: : I like somebody! A girl! Well...woman. So I clearly don’t-
lines.zh: : 我有喜欢的人了！是个女孩！啊不……是女人。所以我显然不会——

lines.en: : Niki, right?
lines.zh: : 是 Niki，对吧？

lines.en: : No, it’s-
lines.zh: : 不是，那是——

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary25
: Wait, how do you know that? What’d she tell you? How much do you know?
lines.zh: : 等等，你怎么知道的？她跟你说了什么？你知道多少？

lines.en: : Well, now I know that {i}she{/i} knows. So that’s new information to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，现在我倒是知道{i}她{/i}知道了。这对我来说是新情报。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary26
: Oh, god damn it!
lines.zh: : 哦，该死！

lines.en: : It was your terrible beach confession speech that was very clearly not written for me that clued me in.
lines.zh: : 是你那次在海滩上糟糕透顶的告白词露的馅——那稿子显然不是为我写的。

lines.en: : And also the fact that she had a very abrupt non-answer on the phone when I told her about you and Rin breaking up.
lines.zh: : 还有，我在电话里跟她说你和 Rin 分手的时候，她的回答回避得特别突兀。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary27
: But that speech was bullet-proof. How did you {i}ever{/i} see through it?
lines.zh: : 可那段词是天衣无缝的啊。你到底是怎么{i}看穿{/i}的？

lines.en: : You wanted me to see through it even earlier, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你其实还想让我更早看穿吧？

lines.en: : I may have been in desperate need of some advice in regard to whether or not this would ever be a plausible scenario for me.
lines.zh: : 我当时可能确实急需有人指点我，这事对我来说到底有没有可能成。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary28
: But...I get now that it’s not. And that you probably wouldn’t give me any advice on how to hook up with your girlfriend anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过……我现在明白了，不可能。而且你大概也不会给我任何关于怎么泡你女朋友的指点。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary29
: Or, shall I say- {i}one{/i} of your girlfriends.
lines.zh: : 或者，我应该说——你的{i}其中一位{/i}女朋友。

lines.en: : This would be a good time to blackmail you if I was one of the bad guys.
lines.zh: : 如果我是坏人的话，现在就是勒索你的好时机。

lines.en: : Do you want to both be bad guys for a second while I propose a trade?
lines.zh: : 你想不想让我俩都当一秒钟的坏人，听我提个交易？

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary30
: You have my attention.
lines.zh: : 你引起我注意了。

lines.en: : I think we both have something that the other person wants.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们俩手里都有对方想要的东西。

lines.en: : You give me Niki, I give you Nodoka? Deal. Take her. As far away as you can.
lines.zh: : 你把 Niki 给我，我把 Nodoka 给你？成交。带走吧。爱带多远带多远。

lines.en: : I give you a {i}picture{/i} of Niki...
lines.zh: : 我给你一张 Niki 的{i}照片{/i}……

lines.en: : And you-
lines.zh: : 然后你——

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary31
: And I give you one of Rin!
lines.zh: : 然后我给你一张 Rin 的！

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: : Wow! This is really fucked up! I’m in!
lines.zh: : 哇！这可真是够变态的！我加入！

lines.en: : And I’m...
lines.zh: : 而我……

lines.en: menu:
Just kidding
lines.zh: 开玩笑的

lines.en: : ...not being serious. Sorry, Otoha.
lines.zh: : ……不是认真的。抱歉，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary32
: Bruh...
lines.zh: : 兄弟……

lines.en: : You’re really gonna do me like that?
lines.zh: : 你真要这么对我？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve screwed over enough people already. And even if I don’t have anything to lose, I don’t think I’m ready to stoop low enough to trade nudes of the girls I know like they’re currency.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我已经坑够多的人了。而且就算我没什么可失去的，我也不觉得自己已经堕落到了会把认识的女孩子们的裸照当货币来交易的地步。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary33
: Are you {i}sure?{/i} I’ve got some pretty {i}spicy{/i} ones, Akira. No one ever has to knooooow.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}吗？我手里可是有些相当{i}劲爆{/i}的，Akira。不会有人知道的啦。

lines.en: : Wow. You really want these, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你是真想要这些啊，是吧？

lines.en: : My imagination can only take me so far.
lines.zh: : 我的想象力也就只能带我走到这儿了。

lines.en: : Aren’t you a writer?
lines.zh: : 你不是个作家吗？

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary34
: For the sake of this conversation, let’s say...no. I am not.
lines.zh: : 为了这场对话能继续下去，就当……不是吧。我不是。

lines.en: : Let’s just...keep what’s in our phones to ourselves for now and...forget I ever made this proposition. Niki would kill me for even joking about it.
lines.zh: : 我们就……暂时各自把手机里存的东西留着，然后……当我从没提过这个提议。Niki 要是知道我连开玩笑都这么讲，会杀了我的。

lines.en: : And Rin-
lines.zh: : 还有 Rin——

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary35
: Actually, I’m not sure how Rin would feel. She might be into it. But I was admittedly never in-tune with her feelings, soooo...maybe not.
lines.zh: : 其实我不确定 Rin 会怎么想。她可能会有兴趣。不过说实话，我从来没能跟她的感受同频过，所以……大概不会吧。

lines.en: : I say we just seize this rare opportunity to be good people and do that for once. Even if it leads to not experiencing things we would very much like to experience.
lines.zh: : 我说，我们就抓住这个难得的机会当一回好人吧，就当这一回。哪怕结果是我们体验不到那些我们非常想体验的东西。

lines.en: : I agree. Reluctantly, of course. But I agree.
lines.zh: : 我同意。虽然是不情不愿地。但我同意。

lines.en: scene black
: And I thank you for your time, but I must now go back to...not being a writer.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的时间，我现在得回去继续……不做作家了。

lines.en: : And I must now go home and jerk off to nudes of a famous idol that you won’t ever see naked.
lines.zh: : 而我现在得回家，对着那位你永远别想看到她裸体的知名偶像的裸照打飞机了。

lines.en: : You are the worst brother I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 你是我有过的最差劲的弟弟。

lines.en: I exit the library and...
lines.zh: 我走出图书馆，然后……

lines.en: I feel a little better.
lines.zh: 我感觉好了一点。

lines.en: Today was okay.
lines.zh: 今天还算不错。

lines.zh: : 卧槽。就算是你，这也够变态的。

lines.en: : Hey, you agreed to go along with it. You’re no better than I am.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你可是答应一起干的。你比我好不到哪儿去。

lines.en: : I still don't have your number th-
lines.zh: : 我还没有你的号码呢——

{i}You have obtained Otoha Okakura's phone number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你获得了 Otoha Okakura 的电话号码！{/i}

lines.en: : Well, that was way too easy.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可太容易了。

lines.en: : You're {i}positive{/i} this is cool?
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}这没问题？

lines.en: : We're in too deep now, aren't we? You gave me your phone number and everything. There's no turning back.
lines.zh: : 我们已经陷得太深了，不是吗？你连电话号码都给我了。没有回头路了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but {i}I’m{/i} getting a picture of a famous idol I have no shot with and you’re getting a picture of some random high school girl who you’re probably going to fuck one day anyway.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过{i}我{/i}拿到的是一张我根本没戏的知名偶像的照片，而你拿到的是某个普通高中女生的照片——反正你大概迟早有一天会操到她。

lines.en: : Fair point. Send me {i}your{/i} nudes as well.
lines.zh: : 有道理。把{i}你的{/i}裸照也发给我。

lines.en: : Ew, no. You can have Rin and that’s it. My body is a temple and only one person is allowed to enter it at this moment in time.
lines.zh: : 恶，不行。你拿了 Rin 的就够了。我的身体是一座神庙，眼下只有一个人可以进去。

lines.en: : I bet that number would go up if I were twenty years younger.
lines.zh: : 我要是年轻二十岁，那个数字大概会往上加吧。

lines.en: : And I’m going to pretend you didn’t just say that. Are we doing this or not?
lines.zh: : 我就当你没说过这话。我们到底还干不干了？

lines.en: : We’re doing this. But no one can ever know.
lines.zh: : 干。但这件事绝对不能让任何人知道。

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: : Seriously. I’m trusting you. Niki’s career could be in serious jeopardy if this gets into the wrong hands.
lines.zh: : 说真的。我信任你。这东西要是落到不该落的人手里，Niki 的事业就完蛋了。

lines.en: : I will not tell you what I am going to do with this picture, but I can confirm that it will definitely not be “destroying her career.”
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉你我打算拿这张照片做什么，但我可以确认，那绝对不是"毁掉她的事业"。

lines.en: : Promise?
lines.zh: : 保证？

lines.en: : Yes. And if I go back on my word, I’ll let you do anything you want to me for ten whole minutes. That’s how serious I am.
lines.zh: : 保证。要是我食言，我让你对我做任何你想做的事，整整十分钟。我就是这么认真。

lines.en: : That’s barely enough time to do anything.
lines.zh: : 十分钟根本不够干什么事啊。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary37
: How much time do you need?!
lines.zh: : 那你要多久？！

lines.en: : Twenty or I walk.
lines.zh: : 二十分钟，不然我就走。

lines.en: scene otohanodokalibrary38
: Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Pleasure doing business with you, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 合作愉快，Otoha。

lines.en: : You as well, Akira. Now, please excuse me while I go somewhere private.
lines.zh: : 你也是，Akira。那么失陪了，我去个没人的地方。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha runs off to...probably the bathroom while Nodoka remains blissfully unaware about all that’s happening behind her.
lines.zh: Otoha 跑开了……大概是去洗手间，而 Nodoka 对自己身后发生的一切仍然毫不知情，幸福得很。

lines.en: Is this a terrible, disgusting idea? Probably. And it jeopardizes not one, but {i}two{/i} of my closest relationships.
lines.zh: 这是个糟糕又恶心的主意吗？大概是。而且它危及的不只是一段，而是{i}两{/i}段我最亲近的关系。

lines.en: Like I said earlier, though...I have nothing to lose anymore.
lines.zh: 不过就像我之前说的……我已经没什么可失去的了。

lines.en: So as I scroll through the pictures in my phone (That I had to restore from my computer after Ami deleted all of them), I sigh to myself, knowing that I’m a terrible person.
lines.zh: 所以当我翻着手机里的照片（Ami 把那些照片全删了，我不得不从电脑里恢复）时，我对自己叹了口气，心里清楚我是个糟糕透顶的人。

lines.en: But that’s nothing new.
lines.zh: 但这也不是什么新鲜事了。

lines.en: I’ve known it all along.
lines.zh: 我从一开始就知道。

lines.en: And the sudden beep of my phone is just the newest symbol of that.
lines.zh: 而手机突然响起的那声提示音，不过是关于这一点最新的象征。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Rin.
lines.zh: 对不起，Rin。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Niki.
lines.zh: 对不起，Niki。
